Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone 16:9 landscape environment painting for the Live2D character stage of Tsukuyomi Space. This is an ART BACKGROUND ONLY, not a webpage or UI screenshot.
Primary request: design a beautiful intimate lakeside room in spring daylight, harmonizing with the website's moon-white and sakura-pink Japanese anime illustrations.
Input images: reference 1 is the current grey apartment, used ONLY to understand an empty character stage, not an edit target; reference 2 is the website spring artwork and supplies the desired illustration rendering and spring palette. Create an original refreshed room.
Scene: a cozy contemporary Japanese lakeside bedroom and reading room, viewed frontally from standing eye level with straight architectural verticals and natural perspective. Pale honey wood floor and window frames, warm ivory plaster, softly rounded furniture and cushions. A large panoramic window along the back wall reveals a calm blue lake, distant Japanese rooftops, mountains and soft sakura blossoms. Simple sheer curtains gathered at the extreme edges. On the far left a modest built-in bookshelf and a low round reading table; on the far right a low bed/daybed and a small warm paper lamp. Furniture is quiet, lived-in and visually coherent, with very few small props.
Composition/framing: full-bleed wide landscape. The central 45% of the room is OPEN EMPTY FLOOR in the foreground, with an unobstructed, calm midtone pastel blue-lilac window view behind it. A standing full-body Live2D girl will be composited in the centre later: do NOT draw her. Keep the centre 9:16 crop beautiful and spacious for mobile. Low bed and bookshelf remain in the outer wings, not in front of the character. Do not put a window mullion or bright sun directly behind the future face at centre upper third. Horizon and window sill around middle of image; comfortable floor depth below. No central chair/table/foreground obstruction.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted Japanese anime environment art, delicate crisp lines and soft painterly light, clear materials and balanced detail, matching the supplied website landscape. Sophisticated softness, not photorealistic, not a 3D render. Pastel sakura pink, moon white, dusty lavender and lake blue, natural pale wood. Spring AFTERNOON daylight, airy but not washed out, gentle bounced sunlight, subtle shadows, no moon or indoor lights turned on during daytime.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no silhouette placeholders, no Live2D character, no UI, no logos, no writing or labels, no watermark, no panel grid, no borders. A single complete usable room image, not a collage. Background should support and never compete with the overlaid character. Do not add busy indoor petals or floating particles.
